items.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18
items.q: I run into a trombone player named Tram... I used to play with that band.

ctx.x: I never did make a job in New Orleans, because my father wouldn't let me. Papa wouldn't let me. But they used to go to New Orleans and give all of those bands in New Orleans a fit. And they used to play. I mean really cut them. Really? Yes, sir. This Tush Johnson's band was really a good band. What did Tush Johnson play? Played banjo and guitar.
Uh, I run into a trombone player named Tram, not, uh, when I was up in Seattle. I used to play with that band. Oh, yeah?
